scope: Publicly documented metadata and data categories; not private user metadata or proprietary telemetry
terminology_note: The official corporate site identifies the company as ByteDance. This inventory therefore treats 'BitDance' as an unverified variant rather than assuming it is an official corporate name.

message_metadata: when a message or prompt was sent
username that can associate content with an account
ai_interaction_metadata: metadata associated with prompts, questions, files, and AI interactions
location: approximate location inferred from SIM region, IP address, and device settings
approximate or precise location when location services are enabled
content_characteristics: potential biometric identifiers/information such as faceprints and voiceprints where applicable
third_party_sources: public profile information from linked services
hashed email addresses and phone numbers
information from advertiser/measurement partners about pages visited, purchases, and apps downloaded

security_and_retention.retention: The US policy says retention varies by data type, purpose, legal/contractual obligations, business interests, and other criteria; it does not provide one universal retention period.

limitations: A privacy policy describes categories and practices; it is not a packet capture or complete technical telemetry specification.
The inventory does not establish that every listed category is collected from every user or on every device.
Jurisdiction, product, settings, permissions, and applicable law can change what is collected or processed.
